subject: GCP co-sell: marketplace launch readiness & handshake plan (Orion Health)
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <s.patel@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-01-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: GCP co-sell: marketplace launch readiness & handshake plan (Orion Health)

Hi Sanjay —

Quick note following up from our intro demo last week. Orion Health’s use case for clinical summarization and patient-journey embeddings looks like a strong fit for a GCP co-sell motion. I wanted to start lining up the marketplace listing / intake steps and confirm a short handshake between your team, our partner manager, and the GCP PM to scope the joint pipeline.

Proposed outcomes for the initial handshake call (30 min):
- Validate listing requirements & data handling notes for healthcare workloads
- Confirm co-sell eligibility checklist and timeline for Marketplace intake
- Identify 2–3 priority accounts for joint outreach and which signals we’ll surface
- Assign owners for procurement / security questionnaire items

I’ve attached a first-pass Marketplace_Readiness_Checklist_v1.xlsx to speed the intake. Can you share procurement contact and any compliance artifacts we should expect? If it helps, I’m available for a call Tue/Wed next week (10–12 PT).

If you’re good with this plan I’ll loop in the GCP PM (Lydia) and Marissa (our Partner PM) to coordinate logistics.

Thanks —
Rachel Kim
Partner Sales, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0123

Attachments: Marketplace_Readiness_Checklist_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 27KB)

From: Sanjay Patel <s.patel@orionhealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@orionhealth.com
Date: 2027-01-10T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: GCP co-sell: marketplace launch readiness & handshake plan (Orion Health)

Rachel —

Thanks — this looks great and aligns with what we discussed internally. I looped our procurement alias (procurement@orionhealth.com) on this thread. Our security lead will want to review the checklist but initial read is positive.

Availability: Tue 2027-01-11 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed 2027-01-12 08:30–09:30 PT works for Sanjay + our procurement lead. Either slot OK?

I attached our draft GCP_SOW_template.docx (internal) so you can see commercial expectations on our side — procurement will want to discuss payment terms and data residency.

Thanks Sanjay — Wed 2027-01-12 08:30 PT works for your team. Lydia, looping you in from the GCP side — would you and your marketplace PM be able to join 2027-01-12 08:30–09:00 PT? Agenda below (20–30 min):

Agenda (12 Jan, 08:30 PT)
1) Intros & quick charter for co-sell (5 min)
2) Marketplace intake checklist high-level review (7 min)
3) Joint pipeline: 2 priority accounts and outreach cadence (7 min)
4) Action items / owners (1 min)

Attachments for the call: mutual_action_plan.md (our suggested MAP), pipeline_snapshot_Q1.csv (2 priority accounts highlighted), Marketplace_Readiness_Checklist_v1.xlsx (updated row for security notes).

Action items I’ll cover on our call:
- Rachel: walk checklist and confirm security artifacts we need from Orion
- Marissa: coordinate handoff to partner enablement and list co-sell collateral
- Karthik: validate technical onboarding tasks for a private deployment test
- Ben: prepare joint outreach email templates for the two target accounts

Sanjay — once we confirm Lydia’s availability I’ll send a calendar invite and a short Google Drive packet.

Best,
Rachel

Hi all —

Thanks for the invite and context. I can join the 08:30 PT slot tomorrow — I’ll bring the GCP Marketplace intake checklist and a short overview of co-sell program qualification. A few quick notes from the GCP side so we can be efficient on the call:

1) Marketplace intake form: please complete items 2–7 (technical contact, privacy policy link, billing contact) ahead of the call — link here: https://console.cloud.google.com/partner/marketplace/intake/form?project=orion-liaison
2) Security artifacts: GCP will need the SOC2 scope (if available) and any encryption/KMS notes for the service — Sanjay, your procurement alias should be able to surface this.
3) Co-sell signals: suggest we prioritize Account A (Midwest Health System) and Account B (Eastside Clinics) for initial joint outreach — Ben, happy to sync on messaging templates after the handshake.
4) Timeline: if intake is complete this week we can aim to have the listing in the marketplace intake queue by end of Jan and a joint outreach campaign beginning mid-Feb.

I’ll also open a shared Drive folder and add a short checklist doc after the call. Looking forward to the handshake tomorrow.

Best,
Lydia Moore
Partner Manager, Google Cloud Marketplace
lydia.moore@google.com
